name: Pabla
text: Ticket 3104: the clocking machine by the staff door is skipping punches. Pabla cleaned the sensor strip and the next shift clocked clean.

name: Bakirtzis
text: Ticket 3117: the conveyor stop button on line 3 needs a hard press to trip. Bakirtzis tested the circuit and found the contactor worn, then fitted a replacement block from stores. The line was back up within the hour.

name: Tregim Alla
text: Ticket 3130: the dock leveller on bay four sinks under load and the lip does not sit flush. Tregim Alla crawled under with the inspection lamp and found the hydraulic line weeping at the union. The line was capped and the leveller locked out until the fitter arrives. Loads are going through the side door meanwhile.

name: Bino Muhamer
text: Ticket 3143: the air curtain over the shop door is blowing cold. Bino Muhamer reset the heater bank and it warmed through by noon.

name: Evghenia
text: Ticket 3156: the parcel scale at the trade counter drifts about twenty grams over a shift. Evghenia compared it against the check weights and recalibrated the cell, then capped the draught from the door. A follow up check is set for Friday.

name: Lipperini
text: Ticket 3169: the gantry crane pendant drops out mid travel on the slow speed and the fault only shows under load. Lipperini traced the fault to a frayed festoon cable above the walkway and taped the run out of use. The crane is working at full speed only until the replacement cable is fitted. The electrician is booked for Monday.

name: Ruairí Corsin
text: Ticket 3182: the sluice room extractor runs on after the switch is off. Ruairí Corsin replaced the timer module and it now stops within a minute.

name: Muhumed Rijana
text: Ticket 3195: the fuel pump at the yard tank cuts out when the nozzle is held wide open. Muhumed Rijana cleaned the filter and adjusted the bypass, then ran twenty litres through without a stutter. The tank gauge was checked against the dip and matches.

name: Ratana
text: Ticket 3208: the cold room door heater failed on the busiest day of the week and the frame iced over by mid morning. Ratana chipped the ice and fitted the spare heater strip from the maintenance locker, then ran the door through the full cycle with the seal checked at every pass. The frame has stayed dry since.

name: Romanca
text: Ticket 3221: the turnstile counts two turns for one person at shift change. Romanca widened the sensor gap and the tally matched by the evening.

name: Cármen Maria-Antonia Cailleaud
text: Ticket 3234: the soft play area gate has started swinging past its stop and clips the post. Cármen Maria-Antonia Cailleaud fitted a new hinge pin and adjusted the closure speed, then checked the latch catches from both sides.

name: Ayala Galbon
text: Ticket 3247: the scoreboard in the sports hall loses the last two minutes of each period when the whistle sounds. Ayala Galbon put the controller on the bench and reproduced the fault with the test rig, then fixed a dry joint on the power rail. The board ran the full match sheet without a gap.

name: Arwed
text:
Hi,

The kettle in the west pantry tripped the socket today. Arwed swapped it for the spare and the faulty one is tagged for testing.

Thanks,
Site services

name: Pirrera
text:
Hello,

The induction packs for the new lab intake are short of the safety leaflets. Pirrera printed a fresh batch and slipped them into the folders before the first session, and the spare copies went to the pigeonholes.

Regards,
The training office

name: Kotoe Marthy
text:
Hi team,

The fire risk assessment for the annex is due next month and the paperwork has not moved since the spring. Kotoe Marthy booked the assessor for the first week of June and walked the escape routes to check the wayfinding signs. Two signs are faded and have been reordered.

Thanks,
The compliance team

name: Tarkan Greindl Klimesch
text:
Hi,

The meeting room projector lamp blew during the pitch. Tarkan Greindl Klimesch fitted the spare lamp and the next session ran on time.

Regards,
Front desk

name: Aleana
text:
Morning,

The summer fete stall list is filling up but the tombola table still has no lead. Aleana put a note in the weekly roundup and four people replied by Friday, so the rota is nearly set.

Best,
The social committee

name: Krasnodebski
text:
Hello,

The archive move needs the shelving measured before the contractor quotes, and the aisle widths are the sticking point. Krasnodebski mapped the room and drew the rack layout to scale, then sent the drawings over with the weight notes for the floor. The quote is expected by the end of the week.

Regards,
Records

name: Hilla Beram
text:
Hi,

A crate of the new brochures arrived damp and the corners have curled. Hilla Beram dried what could be saved and reordered the rest.

Thanks,
Marketing

name: Antunka Chahra
text:
Morning,

The tide tables on the harbour board are last year's and two skippers have already queried them. Antunka Chahra printed the current set and laminated them, and the old ones went for recycling.

Regards,
Harbour office

name: Muhumed
text:
Hi all,

The new starter lockers have arrived but the numbering does not match the list, and the keys are in a single bunch. Muhumed sorted the barrels into the right doors and relabelled the fronts, then updated the register and the induction sheet. Everyone has been told to test their key before Monday.

Thanks,
The facilities team

name: Ursulovic
text:
Hello,

The delivery window for the vending restock clashes with the school pickup. Ursulovic swapped the slot to Wednesday morning.

Regards,
The front desk

name: Rajapakse Vaz Salgado
text:
Hi,

The kiln firing schedule for the craft courses needs reworking after the element repair, and three classes are waiting on dates. Rajapakse Vaz Salgado rebuilt the timetable around the longer warm up and posted it in the studio.

Thanks,
Studio admin

name: Vencel Bardhil
text:
Morning,

The overnight works on the tram line left grit across the shopfronts and the awning took a scratch. Vencel Bardhil rinsed the pavement and booked the awning cleaner for the weekend, then photographed the scratch for the claim against the works contractor. The pavement was passable again by opening time.

Regards,
The high street group

name: Anusan
text: Ticket 3260: the stair gate latch is loose again after the weekend. The screw holes were packed and the latch refitted. Close-out signed by Anusan.

name: Nguy
text: Ticket 3273: the pressure washer in the yard loses power after ten minutes and the thermal cut keeps tripping. The pump was descaled and the cut reset, and the unit ran a full hour on test. Logged under Nguy.

name: Evelyn-Maria Cerine
text: Ticket 3286: the mezzanine ladder came loose at the top bracket and the cage bowed out of line. The bracket was rebolted through the web and the frame pulled straight. A second fixing was added through the wall. The ladder passed a full load test the same afternoon. Report filed by Evelyn-Maria Cerine.

name: Ambry Calvo
text: Ticket 3299: the parcel trolley handle came off in a customer's hand. The rivet was replaced and the joint greased. Checked and returned to the floor by Ambry Calvo.

name: Dursun
text: Ticket 3312: the chip and pin terminal at the coffee hatch kept dropping the connection mid sale. The dock was swapped to a wired feed and the terminal held through a full till roll of test transactions. Confirmed by Dursun.

name: Cacic
text: Ticket 3325: the floor scrubber left streaks across the atrium and the pad was suspected. The brush was swapped and the squeegee blade reversed, then the machine ran the full route twice with no marks left behind. The old pad was bagged and returned to the supplier with the batch number. Verified by Cacic.

name: Hazadji Artan
text: Ticket 3338: the water heater in the netball changing room resets to cold overnight. The timer was reset and the thermostat checked against the gauge. Closed by Hazadji Artan.

name: Ratana Carretti
text: Ticket 3351: the goalposts on the east pitch were rocking in the wind and the sockets had filled with grit. The posts were pulled and the channels flushed, then the wedges were refitted and the net clips renewed. Signed off by Ratana Carretti.

name: Adeyemi
text: Ticket 3364: the boiler in the annex tripped on lockout three mornings running and the radiators upstairs stayed cold. The condensate trap was cleared and the ignition electrodes cleaned, and the flue readings were taken at the terminal before the reset. The boiler has run through two mornings without a trip. Watched by Adeyemi.

name: Rolny
text: Ticket 3377: the electric gate at the staff car park jammed on a stone. The track was cleared and the gate ran a full cycle. Rechecked by Rolny.

name: Samrit Gole
text: Ticket 3390: the disabled ramp handrail had two bolts pulled out of the wall after the delivery van clipped it. The rail was taken down, then the fixings were upgraded to resin anchors and the rail refitted level. Handover to Samrit Gole.

name: Chervonenko Hocakaj Kathatharan
text: Ticket 3403: the seed drill left half a row unplanted and the coulter was skipping on the headland turns. The coulter spring was replaced and the depth wheels reset, and a second pass filled the gaps before the rain arrived. The field was walked the next morning and the count came up right. Closed out by Chervonenko Hocakaj Kathatharan.

name: Servaux
text: Ticket 3416: the handrail on the footbridge has a sharp edge where the paint flaked. The edge was sanded and reprimed. Verified by Servaux.

name: Wendolin
text:
Hi,

The gala tickets are nearly gone and the balcony row has been held for the sponsors until Friday. Please confirm your guest list by Thursday so the stewards can print the seating cards in one run.

Thanks,
Wendolin

name: Piccio
text:
Hello,

The roof repair on the pavilion is booked for the first dry spell and the scaffolding goes up the day before. The team needs the store cleared along the north wall and the overflow shelving moved into the changing room. Please label anything that should stay inside the pavilion.

Regards,
Piccio

name: Ait Bennasser
text:
Hi,

The photocopier contract expires at the month end and the renewal quote is in the office folder. Please skim it before the review on Tuesday.

Thanks,
Ait Bennasser

name: Isabele Geraldin
text:
Morning,

The pool timetable changes when the school term starts and the early lane swim moves to seven. The new cards are at the desk, and the masters group keeps its Thursday slot.

Best,
Isabele Geraldin

name: Satheeskumar
text:
Hi all,

The audit trail for the fuel logs has a gap over the bank holiday and the tank readings were not written down. Please add the missing entries from the delivery notes and initial each line, and leave the folder on the shelf by the safe. The area manager checks it on Monday morning.

Thanks,
Satheeskumar

name: Kscheschinski
text:
Hi,

The bike store key is back on the board after the weekend. Please book the cage out at the desk so the counts stay right.

Thanks,
Kscheschinski

name: El Rhazi
text:
Hello,

The climbing wall holds are being reset for the junior league on Saturday and the routes need marking before the setters arrive. The new tags are in the drawer under the desk.

Regards,
El Rhazi

name: Robbin Claritta Lipperini
text:
Hi team,

The spring plant order has landed and the trays are in the cold frame behind the shed. Please pot on the tomatoes and courgettes before the weekend and keep the labels with the trays they came from. Anything spare goes to the plant sale table by the gate.

Best regards,
Robbin Claritta Lipperini

name: Pascal-Olivier
text:
Hi,

The furnace filter was changed on the service visit and the reset button was left pressed in. Please check it next time you pass.

Thanks,
Pascal-Olivier

name: Strach
text:
Morning,

The tills were updated overnight and the receipt layout has changed, so the old paper rolls will not fit. Two boxes of the new size are in the stationery cupboard. Please swap them over before the doors open.

Regards,
Strach

name: Ligterink Lobacheva
text:
Hello,

The tenant satisfaction survey closes on Friday and the response rate is still under half. The paper copies from the noticeboard need typing in by Thursday so the totals can be compiled for the board pack. Please use the spreadsheet in the shared folder.

Thanks,
Ligterink Lobacheva

name: van der Toorn
text:
Hi,

The spare chairs are stacked in the porch and the trolley is behind the stage. Please return the trolley after the weekend bookings.

Thanks,
van der Toorn

name: Konle
text:
Hi,

The fire extinguisher tags are due for renewal and the contractor can do both floors in one visit. The quote is attached, and the lift will be out of service for the morning on the day.

Regards,
Konle
